fact: As of September 2022 the Ministry of Health's EMR (eRegister, implemented 2018) was fully implemented in 153 of 221 health facilities (69%), with facility reports auto-submitted monthly to DHIS2.
title: Lesotho's Electronic Medical Record Seamlessly Track Progress in Multi-Month Dispensing
publisher: ICAP at Columbia University (CQUIN 6th Annual Meeting poster)
